5) *3sc, increase; rep from * around

10) 36sc - 36 stitches
11) Sc around - 36 stitches

15) (3sc, inv dec) 6 times
16) *2sc, inv dec; rep from * around - 18 stitches
17) (1sc, inv dec) 6 times - 12 stitches
18) Inv dec 6 times - 6 stitches

header: Title: Wavy Pot Holder | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Wavy Pot Holder
Written in US terms.
Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
Materials: worsted weight cotton, 5 mm hook, tapestry needle.
Row 1: Ch 16, starting in 2nd ch from hook, sc across (15)
Row 2: Ch1, turn, single crochet in next 3 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, tr in next 5 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next 3 sts (15)
Row 3: Ch1, turn, 1 single crochet in each st across (15)
Row 4: Ch1, turn, single crochet in next 3 sts, half double crochet in next 2 sts, treble crochet in next 5 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, single crochet in next 3 sts (15)
Row 5-6: Ch1, turn, 1 single crochet in each st across (15)
Row 7: Ch1, turn, sc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, treble crochet in next 3 sts, half double crochet in next 3 sts, single crochet in next 3 sts (15)
Row 8: Ch1, turn, 1 sc in each st across (15)
Row 9: Ch1, turn, sc in next 3 sts, half double crochet in next 3 sts, double crochet in next 3 sts, half double crochet in next 3 sts, sc in next 3 sts (15)
Row 10: Ch1, turn, 1 single crochet in each st across (15)
Row 11: Ch1, turn, single crochet in next st, half double crochet in next 2 sts, double crochet in next 9 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, single crochet in next st (15)
Row 12-13: Ch1, turn, 1 sc in each st across
Row 14: Ch1, turn, single crochet in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, double crochet in next 9 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next st
Row 15: Ch1, turn, 1 single crochet in each st across (15)
Row 16: Ch1, turn, single crochet in next st, half double crochet in next 3 sts, dc in next 7 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, single crochet in next st (15)
Rows 17-18: Ch1, turn, 1 sc in each st across (15)
Fasten off and weave in ends.

US terms.

You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
Ch 14

R2-5: CH 3 (counts as DC), turn, DC in next st and in each st across (12)
R6-R14: CH 3 (counts as first DC), turn, DC in each st across (12)
R15-16: CH 3 (counts as 1 DC throughout), turn, DC in each st across (12)
Do not turn. Work a border if you like (not covered here).

header: Title: Sunny Bun | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Sunny Bun
US crochet terms used throughout. Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
R1. 6 sc in MR (6 sts)
R2. 2 sc in each st around (12 sts)
R3. [sc, inc] 6x (18 sts)
R4. Sc, inc, [sc 2, inc] 5x, sc (24 sts)
R5. [sc 3, inc] 6x (30 sts)
R6. *sc 4, inc; rep from * around (36 sts)
R7. [sc 5, inc] 6x (42 sts)
R8-11. 1 sc in each st around (42 sts)
Place safety eyes between Rnd 8 and 9, about 6 sts apart.
R12. [sc 5, sc dec] 6x (36 sts)
Start stuffing, adding more as you go.
R13. *sc 4, sc dec; rep from * around (30 sts)
R14. [sc 3, sc dec] 6x (24 sts)
R15. [sc 2, sc dec] 6x (18 sts)
R16. [sc, sc dec] 6x (12 sts)
R17. [sc dec] 6x (6 sts)
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Soft Ball | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Soft Ball
Written in US terms. Each round is worked in joined rounds: join with a sl st to the first st.
RND 1: Ch 2, 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join with a sl st - 8 stitches.
RND 2: Ch 1, repeat sc inc eight times, sl st to join - 18 stitches.
RND 3: Ch 1, repeat (sc, sc inc) eight times, join - 24 stitches.
RND 4: Ch 1, sc 2, sc inc, repeat (sc 2, sc inc) seven times, sc, sl st to join - 32 stitches.
RNDS 5-9: Ch 1, sc 32, join with sl st to first sc - 32 stitches.
RND 10: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join - 32 stitches.
RND 11: Ch 1, repeat (sc 2, sc dec) eight times, join with a sl st - 24 stitches.
RND 12: Ch 1, *sc, sc dec* around, sl st to join - 16 stitches.
RND 13: Ch 1, *sc dec* around, join - 8 stitches.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

text:

RND 1: 8 sc in MR (8 sts).
RND 2: Sc around (8 sts).
RND 3: *sc in next st, 2 sc in same st* 4 times (12 sts).

RND 18: *sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in same st* 4 times.
RND 19: Sc around (36 sts).

header: Title: Happy Ball | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Happy Ball
US terms. Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
Materials: worsted weight yarn, 4 mm hook, stuffing, tapestry needle.
RND 1: MR, 6 sc (6 sts).
RND 2: [2 sc in next st] x6 (12 sts).
RND 3: [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] x6 (18 sts).
RND 4: Rep (sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) around (24 sts).
RND 5: Rep (sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st) around.
RND 6: [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] x6 (36 sts).
RND 7: Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] x5, sc in next 3 sts (42 sts).
RND 8: Sc in next 42 sts (42 sts).
RND 9: Sc in next 42 sts (42 sts).
RND 10: Sc in each st around (42 sts).
RNDS 11-12: Sc in next 42 sts (42 sts).
RND 13: Sc in each st around (42 sts).
RND 14: Rep (sc in next 5 sts, dec) around (36 sts).
Start stuffing, adding more as you go.
RND 15: [sc in next 4 sts, dec] x6 (30 sts).
RND 16: [sc in next 3 sts, dec] x6 (24 sts).
RND 17: [sc in next 2 sts, dec] x6 (18 sts).
RND 18: [sc in next st, dec] x6.
RND 19: [dec] x6 (6 sts).
